examples.description: Show a red frame, colored lettering, panel information and a six-color swatch on the Paper Color display.
Show battery and USB input readings and indicate external power with the two onboard LEDs.
Show a startup prompt and report presses of the three Paper Color buttons over serial.
Send NEC infrared frames on the onboard transmitter and show the current address and command.
Cycle the two onboard RGB LEDs through single-pixel, mixed and matched colors.
Draw six colored bands and a multicolored label on the e-paper display using an offscreen canvas.
